about.title: About me
paragraphs: I started my first hospitality job at 15, working my way up from dishwasher to bar manager at one of Amsterdam’s top cocktail bars. When COVID hit, I discovered a passion for coding and began learning Python and JavaScript through online courses. I realized how much I enjoyed seeing things I created come to life.

Since then, I’ve focused on web development. I completed a project-based internship, building mock projects designed to simulate real-world workflows, and delivered two real-world projects independently. I have experience with both Web Components and React, focusing on front-end development, and I aim to eventually expand into back-end work.
Outside of coding, I train Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, which has taught me discipline, perseverance, and the value of tackling complex problems step by step.
I’m looking to take the next step into tech through a junior role, internship, or traineeship where I can grow, learn, and contribute to meaningful projects.
